notes: Connect the radio's micro-USB (data) port to the computer.
On Apply, LiaisonOS records this USB adapter so it maps to /dev/et-kiss.
The internal TNC is switched to KISS automatically (KISS ON + RESTART)
when you start an APRS (USB) or Chattervox (USB) session.
If you have more than one USB serial adapter plugged in, connect only the
TH-D72 when you Apply, so the right one is captured.
